series.context:
Prior events (Part 1): Examiner Satotz leads the applicants to the entrance of the foggy Numere Wetlands, warning them that deceitful monsters roam the marsh. The massive gates shut behind them, cutting off retreat as the runners plunge into the blinding mist.
Prior events (Part 2): Killua warns Gon to move toward the front because Hisoka is lingering in the rear looking for blood. As Leorio falls behind from exhaustion, deceptive predators attack the applicants through the mist, leaving Kurapika and Leorio isolated.
Prior events (Part 3): A squad of armed applicants corners Hisoka in the fog, attempting to assassinate the magician before he strikes. Hisoka effortlessly slaughters them with razor-sharp cards, leaving Kurapika and Leorio frozen in terror when they witness the massacre.
Prior events (Part 4): Kurapika urges Leorio to flee, but Leorio refuses to run from a monster and attacks Hisoka with a wooden club. Just as Hisoka readies a fatal counter, Gon's fishing rod strikes Hisoka square in the face from above.
Prior events (Part 5): Hisoka evaluates Gon after the boy's strike. When Gon attacks again, Hisoka seizes him by the throat, admiring his fearless glare. After knocking out an intervening Leorio, Hisoka spares both boys and carries Leorio toward the finish line.
